core_memory.morning_routine: Wake up around 6:30, check calendar, stretch for 15-30 minutes.
core_memory.breakfast_routine: Scrambled eggs and spinach, whole wheat toast, coffee(if time), or granola bar and fruit.
core_memory.afternoon_routine: Finalize small tasks, use digital task manager, categorize tasks by class/project, break down into subtasks with deadlines.
core_memory.evening_departure: Leaves campus around 6:00-7:00 PM, attends Robotics Club meetings weekly.
core_memory.weekend_routine: Saturday: Longer assignments/project milestones, fun activities(sailing, gatherings). Sunday: Group study session with classmates, internship/job application prep.
